overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed data storage systems where data may be temporarily inconsistent across multiple nodes, but will eventually become consistent. This means that after a write operation, the data might not be immediately available everywhere, but it will be eventually. This is a trade-off between performance and consistency, often used in NoSQL databases to handle large-scale data storage and retrieval.
